title: Counter patch on the frame
statement: Let $w$ and $v$ be words over an alphabet, let $ct$ be an integer-indexed tape of optional symbols, and let $cp$ be an integer. Suppose $v$ and $w$ have equal lengths, and throughout the range $-1 \le p \le |w|$, the tape $ct$ at position $cp+p$ agrees with the buffered tape storing $w$ at position $p$. Then throughout the range $-1 \le p \le |v|$, patching $ct$ with $v$ beginning at $cp$ yields the buffered tape storing $v$ at position $cp+p$.
